svg.title: Harness layers around the raw LLM
svg.desc: The agent harness sits between the application and the model. Its five components are the execution loop, the tool registry the loop calls in both directions, the prompt assembler that builds the prompt the model receives, the state manager that holds checkpoints, and the observer that logs every step. The model only reasons.
svg.text: // HARNESS LAYERS AROUND THE RAW LLM
